resources.name: Get_Attributes_For_Item_Type 4.1
resources.description:
Endpoint specs : https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/taxonomy#get-/assignments

//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Use the Taxanomy Id (item_type id) from 1.1 and pass it as query parameter.

Note : Taxanomy Id (item_type id) is different for each item type

//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The endpoint is used by both Target (1P/2P business) and Target+ (3P business/us). Some of the details you might see are related to 1P business. So for each of the attribute only fetch the fileds as highlighted below 
	
	{
		"taxonomy_id": "root",
		"attribute_id": "1446051420",
		"required": false,
		"max_selections": 1,
		"attribute": {
			"name": "Bullet Feature 11",
			"description": "Highlights or features about the product, up to fifteen bullets.",
			"type": "TEXT",
			"attribute_group": "CORE",
			"mapped_property": "descriptions.bullets[11]"
		}
	}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We have 4 different types of attributes. 
1. Text ( Free Text.  Eg : Brand : Nike ) 
2. Measure ( Numeric with predefined units. Eg : Package Weight : 12 Pounds ) 
3. Value ( Attributes with predefined list of values )
4. Integer ( Just Numerics without any units Eg : product Quantity : 12 )



//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Attribute GROUPS**
For T+ we we only use SELLING┃CORE┃TAX┃LOGISTICS attribute GROUPS

**CORE** or **root** : A set of common attributes assigned to all the item types.

**SELLING**          : Item type specific attributes.

**TAX**              : Common attribute assigned to all the Item type, based on whose value tax will be calculated. You should choose a value that is closest to your item and if there isn't an item type specific tax value, please use the General value.

**LOGISTICS**        : These are logistics attributes, updated via the product_logistics endpoint. 
https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/seller#put-/sellers/-seller_id-/product_logistics/-product_id-


//--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

parameters.name: taxonomy_id
parameters.value: Item Type ID from ALLOWED_ITEM_TYPES Report

resources.name: Create_SA_Items 6.1
resources.description:
Endpoint : https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/seller#post-/sellers/-seller_id-/products

**Note 1**: This is provided as a template for your reference on how to structure the JSON. The attributes and values listed in this file must be updated to reflect the assigned attributes list for your specific item type. 

 

**Note 2**: Do not include Logistics attributes when sending the item content data. Logistics attributes must be sent after the item is created, over the Product Logistics endpoint. Refer 9.1
 
**Note 3**: You will not see "item_type.name" as one of attributes when you fetch the assigned attribute list for an item type, but it must be included as it is a required attribute. 

 

**Note 4**: When updating an item, you must repost the entire fields section with all the existing attributes that you want to retain, regardless of whether they need modification, and any new attributes that you might want to include. Note that you must include the product_id in the PUT call to the Modify Products endpoint. 


**Note 5**: Variation Attributes, Parent title, Parent Image url  should not be used for Stand Alone (SA) items.

resources.name: Create Product-VAP/3VC - Size Variation 6.2
resources.description:
Endpoint : https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/seller#post-/sellers/-seller_id-/product_variation_update

**Note 1**: This is provided as a template for your reference on how to structure the JSON. The attributes and values listed in this file must be updated to reflect the assigned attributes list for your specific item type. 

 

**Note 2**: Do not include Logistics attributes when sending the item content data. Logistics attributes must be sent after the item is created, over the Product Logistics endpoint. Refer 9.1
 
**Note 3**: You will not see "item_type.name" as one of attributes when you fetch the assigned attribute list for an item type, but it must be included as it is a required attribute. 

 

**Note 4**: When updating an item, you must repost the entire fields section with all the existing attributes that you want to retain, regardless of whether they need modification, and any new attributes that you might want to include. Note that you must include the product_id in the PUT call to the Modify Products endpoint. 


**Note 5**: Parent/VAP item should include only attributes that are common to all variations in the parent-child relationship. Attributes that differ between the child items should be included only at the VC level

**Note 6**: VCs must include all attributes required for a given item type to list. While VCs inherit the VAP's attributes, we recommend including all required attributes when listing each VC. This ensures that any accidental updates to the VAP do not overwrite the VCs' attributes.


**Note 7**: VAPs (Parent) items are just a shell that holds a set of VCs under them. 
You should not be updating Barcode, Price and Inventory for VAP items.

Endpoint : https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/seller#put-/sellers/-seller_id-/prices/-product_id-


//----------------------------------------------------------------------


Use IDs from 6.1, 6.3 and 6.4

//----------------------------------------------------------------------


"Price will always need to be sent after the item has been created.

List Price= Regular Price
Offer Price= Sale or Discounted Price
MAP= Minimum Advertised Price
 
List Price should always be the highest.
Offer (Sale) Price is when you are selling the item at a discount and will show up XX% off List Price
MAP Price is the minimum price you want the item to sell for.
If you send an Offer price lower than List, you will receive an error.                                                                                        
Note: prices must be greater than 0.00."

//----------------------------------------------------------------------

You should not be updating **Barcode**, **Price** and **Inventory** for VAP items.

resources.name: Update Logistics 9.1
resources.description:
Endpoint : https://plus.target.com/docs/spec/seller#put-/sellers/-seller_id-/product_logistics/-product_id-

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**seller_return_policy** will be documented on your API Token Information word doc

and use Use product_id from 6.1,6.2, 6.3 or 6.4

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**fulfillment.two_day_shipping_eligible**

Values: Yes, No	

Default value: No	

Adding Two-Day Shipping requires an additional step to add specific states in which you can guarantee shipping. To add states for Two-Day Shipping, you must open a case in the Portal, and the Support & Performance team will update your Distribution Center location with the state(s) tied to each

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**fulfillment.is_add_on**

Values: Yes, No	

Default Value: No

Add-On items are traditionally lower valued items that only ship when a guest's cart is at least $35.
If the field value is Yes, the guest’s cart total must be at least $35 when checking out

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**shipping_exclusion**

Values: Yes, No

Default Value: No

When shipping exclusion is enabled, guests within specific ZIP codes won’t be able to complete a purchase.

Exclusion Areas:
APO/FPO
Alaska
Hawaii
American Samoa
Guam
Northern Mariana Islands
Puerto Rico
Minor Outlying Islands
Virgin Islands

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**seller_return_policy**

Values: 3 letter code ex: AAA, AAB, AAC

Default value: Charge to Partner/Return to Partner via CRC

Specific 3 letter code varies by Partner, found in portal under Basic Info>Return Policies
